body: ## Summary Sending a message to an archived chat restores it first. While the composer said **Restoring session** (7–28 s in the lab), there was no way to attach a file: the **+** button was gone, and a pasted or dropped image was silently dropped. Two gates caused it: 1. `SessionChatSurface` offered no stager while the session row was archived, and the row stays archived for most of the restore. 2. `ChatComposer` refuses paste, drop and the picker while a send is in flight, and an archived chat's send stays in flight for the whole restore. ## Fix - The session surface offers its stager while the restore runs. Staging an archived session's file waits for the restore already tracked under its `resume-agent` mutation key, so nothing is uploaded before the worktree is back. A file removed while it waits is never uploaded. - During a restore the composer takes files for the **next** message, as it already takes typing. It does so only when the message being sent has no files of its own, so sent and next files never share the box. - Accepting the sent message no longer drops a file that is still being staged. - Enter on a box that holds only a file is held and sent next, as it is for text. - A failed restore shows its own reason rather than "Files couldn't be saved". Ordinary sends, New Chat and archived Cloud chats are unchanged. ## Evidence Real desktop app built from this branch, isolated lab, real Claude Code session (Opus 5.5) on a local host. The chat was archived, then "pick this back up" was sent and a PNG was pasted during **Restoring session**. | | During the restore | After the restore | |---|---|---| | Before (`main`) | | | | After (this PR) | | | Measured from the DOM in each run: | | Before | After | |---|---|---| | Attach button during the restore | absent | enabled | | File picker input during the restore | absent | enabled | | Pasted PNG during the restore | dropped | `Attaching screenshot.png` | | Pasted PNG after the restore | none | `screenshot.png` staged and kept | Run on the final code (`a6291c65f4`): two PNGs were pasted during a 4.6 s restore, one was cancelled, and the other was entered with no text. The daemon got `restore`, then one `attachments` POST, and the second message (1 s after the first) carried that one file. With neither cancelled (`f767aefea0`, 35.8 s restore on a loaded machine), both files were uploaded after the restore and sent in the second message. End to end: the next message with that file reached the restored agent, which read `.ao/attachments/attachment-….png` and answered "Orange" (the test image is RGB 255, 80, 40). ## Tests - `useConversation.test.tsx`: staging waits for the restore; a file removed meanwhile or a failed restore stages nothing. - `SessionChatSurface.test.tsx`: an archived session offers the stager while its restore runs. - `ChatComposer.optimistic.test.tsx`: files taken during a restore go with the next message, a file-only Enter is held, a failed restore shows its reason, and no file is taken during an ordinary send or the restore of a message with files of its own. - Removing each behavioural condition in turn makes one of these tests fail. ## Coverage and risks - The changed code has no harness or host branch, so Codex, ACP harnesses and remote hosts take the same path. That is inferred; only Claude on a local host was measured. - If the message being restored already has files (a draft kept from before the chat was archived), attaching stays closed until it lands, as on `main`. - If the send is refused while the next file is still uploading, the refused text and that file end up together in the box, unsent. - Leaving the chat while a file waits for the restore shows the existing "Attachments are still being saved" prompt, now for as long as the restore takes. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **Bug Fixes** * You can now add attachments to the next message while a session is restoring, including while a previous message is still being sent. * Attachments remain available for the next message while they’re being prepared, and can be sent on their own. * Attachment controls are available only when files can be added to a draft. * If session restoration fails, attachment staging reports the error and does not upload files.
title: fix(chat): take files while an archived chat restores
